verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch is driven entirely through its REST API, with extensive official documentation, client libraries for many languages, and a verified hands-on probe confirming a real keyless index+search roundtrip against a locally-run cluster. Official clients and quickstart docs (curl one-liners, Docker) further evidence a documented, usable public API surface. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at standard well-known paths (probe found 404s at openapi.json/swagger.json), and llms.txt/docs.md AI-native discovery files were also 404.
